prompt: Probe pan 1 with the chef arm; if that fails, try once more. Then send the reading to "pass".

paths.when: the probe never works: both readings fail

why: The retry in a `measure`'s handler binds the same name again, so the reading is defined on both paths (0036 V3, option b). A first try that fails and a second that works cannot be forced by a world patch; `tests/test_bench_values.py` forces it with a scripted fault. The request names no end state.
